caption: The drawing shows a rectangular object, possibly a frame or plaque, positioned vertically on a plain, light-colored background. The top of the rectangle is overlain by a large, rounded arch that features an inner scalloped border and vertical linear details. Attached symmetrically to both the left and right sides near the top are large ribbon-like structures with dotted linear patterns running along their length and curved ends. At the bottom corners of the rectangle, there are two circular, rosette-like decorations with petal-shaped segments radiating outwards. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of gray, with darker shading used for definition and contouring, and features a signature reading “Majel G. Claflin - Taos N.M.” in the lower right corner.
title: Small Tin Framed Mirror
